page.notes: Long s and u/v/i/j were normalised as instructed. "p-geniem" is a line-end hyphenated word ("progeniem") and the abbreviation mark before "geniem" is unclear, so it is only partly read. "1. Tim. 2.1. Pet. 3." is copied as printed; the chapter and verse numbers are hard to separate at this resolution. "praedictis" is a likely reading of a worn word. The catchword is absent: the page ends on the hyphenated "con-".
